question: Should the exact reviewed mutation-safety head be promoted from draft and rolled into the live repair workflow now?
rationale: The patch is technically well-supported, but it intentionally changes the availability and security boundary of live authoritative automation; choosing the rollout timing and canary requirement is a maintainer responsibility.

options.title: Canary, then merge
options.body: Confirm the intended head, run one controlled valid-mutation and one stale-drift scenario, then promote and merge if both outcomes match the fail-closed design.

options.title: Merge with owned risk
options.body: Promote and merge the green reviewed head without an additional canary, accepting that production is the first full workflow validation.

options.title: Keep staged
options.body: Leave the PR draft while gathering additional live workflow evidence or narrowing the rollout surface.

recommendation.title: Canary, then merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the intended head, run one controlled valid-mutation and one stale-drift scenario, then promote and merge if both outcomes match the fail-closed design.
